verdict.rationale: Plaid hosts a remote Dashboard MCP server, so an AI assistant can query Production diagnostics, debug Items, review Link conversion data, and check usage metrics through natural-language prompts. That scope covers diagnostics and analytics, not general operation of the product such as initiating payments or managing Items. An llms.txt file aids AI consumption of the docs. Missing for 10: natural-language operation beyond Dashboard diagnostics and analytics, a first-party natural-language command interface in the product itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP experience.
